card.title: Greenhouse vs ozone hole — two atmospheric stories

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Two gases, two crises: greenhouse gases (CO₂, CH₄, N₂O, CFCs) trap outgoing infrared — natural warming plus anthropogenic surplus = global warming → climate shifts, sea rise, extremes. Ozone (stratospheric O₃) instead absorbs UV; CFC chlorine catalytically shreds it (one Cl ~10⁵ O₃), opening the Antarctic hole — healing under the Montreal Protocol. Air/water pollution (particulates, SO₂/NOₓ, sewage, heavy metals), solid waste (segregate–recycle–compost–landfill), nuclear hazards, plus remedies (rainwater harvesting, wasteland greening) complete the unit.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: greenhouse: solar in (shortwave) − IR out (trapped) = warming · gases: CO₂ (fossil) · CH₄ (paddy/livestock) · N₂O · CFCs  ·  ozone: O₂ + UV → 2O · O + O₂ → O₃ · Cl + O₃ → ClO + O₂ (catalytic)  ·  control ladder: reduce → treat → recycle → rehabilitate

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Warming attribution needs long baselines (decades, not weather). Ozone chemistry needs polar stratospheric clouds + spring sunlight (Antarctic specificity). Pollution controls assume source identification first (chimney vs traffic vs biomass). Harvesting math needs catchment × rainfall × runoff coefficient.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Kathmandu winter smog (valley inversion traps particulates) vs summer washout. Montreal Protocol: the rare solved crisis (CFC phase-out, hole recovering). Bhopal/MINAMATA-scale events anchor industrial-hazard answers. Nuclear: α/β/γ hierarchy, half-life logic for waste timescales.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: Distinguish the two crises in one table: greenhouse (tropospheric gases, traps heat, warming/climate, fix = cut emissions) vs ozone hole (stratospheric O₃ loss, CFC chlorine catalysis, UV rise, fix = Montreal phase-out). Conflating them is the classic zero-mark error — location and mechanism differ completely.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Single-issue framing misleads (warming + ozone + pollution interact). Local air quality ≠ global climate (different gases, different fixes). Nuclear risk debates mix physics (dose) with dread (perception) — answers need both acknowledged. Harvesting potentials overpromise without maintenance.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: Energy-balance: Earth radiates σT⁴; greenhouse gases raise the effective emission height to colder layers → surface must warm to restore balance (ΔF = 5.35·ln(C/C₀) per CO₂ doubling). Ozone: Chapman cycle formation vs Cl-catalysed destruction kinetics — rate comparison shows parts-per-billion chlorine dominating natural sinks.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Crisis pairs: warming–CO₂/CH₄–cut emissions; ozone–CFC–Montreal. Pollution answers: source → effect → control (three beats each medium). Waste hierarchy: refuse–reduce–reuse–recycle–recover. Harvesting: rooftop + recharge pits.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB-style: greenhouse mechanism vs ozone depletion (tabulated difference); air/water pollution triads (cause–effect–control); solid-waste hierarchy; Montreal Protocol significance; rainwater-harvesting design.
